description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.
name: Hide floating promotions

description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
name: Hide inbox items

description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
name: Hide inbox stories

description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.
name: Hide Play Store update offer

description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
name: Hide profile shortcuts

description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Hide search suggestions

description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
name: Hide suggested accounts

description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Hide the launcher shortcuts

description: Notes in the diagnostic report when TikTok's account safety check decides to show a verification puzzle. It doesn't hide anything, so it's only useful for research. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.
name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA

description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Hide video overlays

description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock

description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: In-app browser privacy guard

description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
name: Keep a streak going

description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.
name: Keep playing in the background

description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Keep pulled sounds

description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Keep the Favorites tab

description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Keep the screen's refresh rate

description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
name: Lift text length limits

description: Stops TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. It has no switch, so only patching again without it undoes it.
name: Limit background traffic

options.description: Stops TikTok setting up notifications, so you won't get any, messages included. Pausing Hushfeed won't bring them back. Patch again with this off to get them back.
options.title: Skip notification setup

description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown, and can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: LIVE controls

description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Location access governor

description: Lets a long press on a video do something else, like open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Long-press controls

description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Look like the store app

description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Mute feed videos

description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.
name: Network proxy

description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.
name: Network request report

description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Not interested button

description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
name: Notification controls

description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Open external links directly

description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Picture-in-picture

description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Play SDR instead of HDR

description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Playback quality

description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Playback speed

description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Prefer H.264 playback

description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.
name: Region spoof

description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Remember clear display

description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Remove avatar rings

description: Removes TikTok's built-in AI model files, payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 19 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.
name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets

description: Removes TikTok's camera, editing and effects files, saving about 40 MB of storage. The catch: the Create tab and every recording, editing and effects tool stop working.
name: Remove creation tools

description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.
name: Remove LIVE extras

description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.
name: Remove unused language packs

options.description: The languages to keep, as short codes separated by commas, like en, es, pt, fr or de. Type all to keep every language. English is always kept.
options.title: Languages to keep

description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Repost diagnostics

description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Resource and battery governor

description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Resume videos after scrolling

description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.
name: Run beside the store app

description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Settings

description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, and add apps you do use. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
name: Share sheet tools

description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Show author region

description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Show engagement rate

description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Show exact counts

description: Always opens Gboard in incognito mode to disable typing history collection and personalization.
name: Always-incognito mode

description: Blocks ads, trackers, analytics, and unwanted content in apps and games using a hosts file.
name: Block ads, trackers, and analytics

options.description: The hosts file containing hosts or domains you want to block. Select a file or paste the full file path.
options.title: Hosts file

options.description: The IP address to redirect blocked domains to. This will be used with your hosts list to block content.
options.title: Redirection IP

options.description: When enabled, entries like "example.com" also block subdomains like "www.example.com" and "sub.www.example.com".
options.title: Wildcard blocking

description: Appends ".adobo" to the package name by default. Changing the package name of the app can lead to unexpected issues.
name: Change package name

options.description: The name of the package to rename the app to.
options.title: Package name

options.title: Update permissions

options.description: Update other permissions declared by the app. Enabling this can fix installation errors, but this can also break features in certain apps.
options.title: Update other permissions

options.description: Update content provider URI authorities. Enabling this can fix installation errors, but this can also break features in certain apps.
options.title: Update content providers

options.title: Line color 3

options.title: Line color 4

options.description: The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 5.
options.title: Line color 5

options.description: The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 6.
options.title: Line color 6

options.description: The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 7.

options.description: The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 8.
options.title: Line color 8

description: Deactivates Firebase Analytics and removes its associated broadcast receivers and services.
name: Deactivate Firebase Analytics

description: Deactivates the collection of performance data on app start up time, network requests, and other related metrics.
name: Deactivate Firebase Performance Monitoring

description: Prevents the bottom navigation bar from hiding when scrolling down.
name: Disable bottom navigation bar auto-hide

description: Disables the forced update dialog on an outdated app version.
name: Disable forced update dialog

description: Disables the Google Safe Browsing checks in WebView. This doesn't apply to WebView within the SDK Runtime.
name: Disable Google Safe Browsing in WebView

description: Disables the automatic refresh of the home feed after viewing a post or after being away from the app.
name: Disable home feed auto-refresh

description: Disables the back-to-top scroll and home feed refresh on back navigation to exit.
name: Disable home feed refresh on back to exit

description: Disables the horizontal page swipe gesture used to switch feeds.
name: Disable home feed swipe

description: Disables the automatic redirect to the home screen after being away from the app or returning from the background.
name: Disable home screen redirect

description: Disables the collection of diagnostic data or usage statistics that are sent to Google.
name: Disable metrics collection in WebView

description: Disables banner, interstitial, and other ad formats.
name: Disable mobile ads

options.description: Disable App Open, Banner & MREC, Interstitial, Native, and Rewarded ad formats.
options.title: AppLovin MAX

options.description: Disable Banner, Native, Interstitial, Pop-up, Rewarded, and Splash ad formats.
options.title: BIGO

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Native, Rewarded, Rewarded Interstitial, and App Open ad formats.
options.title: Google AdMob

options.description: Disable Banner, Medium rectangle, Interstitial, Native, Native Banner, Rewarded Video, and Rewarded Interstitial ad formats.
options.title: Meta Audience Network

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Rewarded Video, Native, and Splash ad formats.
options.title: Mintegral

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Rewarded, Native, Native Banner, In-Stream Video and Audio, and Carousel ad formats.
options.title: myTarget

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Native, Rewarded Video, and App Open ad formats.
options.title: Pangle

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Native, Rewarded, and App Open ad formats.
options.title: TopOn

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Native, and Rewarded Video ad formats.
options.title: Unity

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Native, Rewarded, and App Open ad formats.
options.title: Liftoff Monetize

options.description: Disable Banner, Interstitial, Native, Rewarded, App Open, InStream, and Feed ad formats.
options.title: Yandex Advertising Network

description: Disables the horizontal swipe gesture used to navigate between posts.
name: Disable post detail swipe

description: Disables the banner that shows up after taking a screenshot.
name: Disable screenshot banner

description: Enables the redesign of the additional actions menu.
name: Enable access points menu redesign

description: Enables clipboard support in incognito mode.
name: Enable clipboard in incognito

description: Enables extending the clipboard history expiration time.
name: Enable extended clipboard history

description: Enables browsing Reddit without signing in.
name: Enable guest mode

description: Enables an option to select a key shape from the theme.
name: Enable key shape selection

description: Enables the Scan Text feature to extract text from images and insert them into text fields.
name: Enable OCR feature

description: Enables the undo feature to quickly undo or correct typing mistakes.
name: Enable Undo feature

description: Enables voice typing in incognito mode.
name: Enable voice typing in incognito

description: Hides the Ask button (Reddit Answers) from the search bar.
name: Hide Ask button from search bar

description: Hides the awards on Reddit posts and comments.
name: Hide awards

description: Hides the community highlights section.
name: Hide community highlights

description: Hides the red notification badge on the community menu (hamburger menu).
name: Hide community menu badge

description: Hides the crosspost on Reddit posts.
name: Hide crosspost

description: Removes the "views" indicator from the post metadata.
name: Hide post view counts

description: Hides the new prominent search bar on the main screen. Applicable only to version 2026.24.0 and earlier.
name: Hide prominent search bar

description: Hides the share count on Reddit posts.
name: Hide share count

description: Hides the scores on Reddit posts and comments.
name: Hide upvote scores

options.description: Removes scores from posts in feeds and search results.
options.title: Hide post scores

options.description: Removes scores from comments in threads and search results.
options.title: Hide comment scores

description: Hides the user community badges on Reddit comments.
name: Hide user community badges

description: Hides the user flairs on Reddit comments.
name: Hide user flairs

description: Sets the system navigation bar to fully transparent.
name: Make system navigation bar transparent

description: Opens external links directly without going through out.reddit.com.
name: Open external links directly

description: Removes ads, trackers, and analytics in the 9GAG app.
name: Remove 9GAG's ads, trackers, and analytics

description: Removes ads and telemetry everywhere.
name: Remove ads and telemetry

description: Removes ads, trackers, and analytics in the IMDb app.
name: Remove IMDb's ads, trackers, and analytics

description: Removes unnecessary internet permission from apps that can still work without internet access.
name: Remove internet permission

description: Prevents the app from detecting when a screenshot is taken.
name: Remove screenshot detection

description: Replaces the Google Maps API key with a custom key.
name: Replace Google Maps API key

options.description:
This key must be a valid Google Maps API key starting with "AIzaSy". 

Follow the instructions at https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/android-sdk/get-api-key to generate a new API key if you don't have one. 

Leave it unrestricted to use it with any app (recommended), or restrict it by adding the SHA-1 fingerprint of the app's signing certificate and the package name.
options.title: Maps API Key

description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
name: Sanitize share links

description: Unshortens and removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
name: Sanitize share links

description: Spoofs the device's advertising ID with a string of zeros.
name: Spoof Advertising ID

description: Spoofs the app's package certificate hash used by Firebase Installations so that push notifications, remote config, and other Firebase services continue to work as expected.
name: Spoof Firebase certificate hash

options.description: The SHA-1 hash of the app's package certificate.
options.title: Certificate hash

description: Spoofs the signature verification when the app starts up. It is recommended to use the unmodified app to work properly.
name: Spoof signature verification

options.description: The package name of the app, if modified. This must match the package name defined when the 'Change package name' patch is selected or as defined in the AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Package name

options.description: The base64-encoded signature from the original, unmodified APK. This extracts the certificate/signature in the APK by default if blank.
options.title: Base64-encoded signature
